== About ==
'''Hammers of Firestorm''' is an online QuakeWorld [[2on2]] team that formed in early [[2025]]. The partnership pairs two experienced players: a Portuguese player known as [[Hammer]] and a Czech player known as [[Flamer]], who teamed up after joining [[Death Dealers]] squad.
